glosses: entitlement, demand, expectation of what should come from someone or something
claim, the right against a subject of law that an action is performed or omitted by it
the raised procedural form of a claim that the defendant do or omit something

examples.text: Wie viel Zeit wird das in Anspruch nehmen?

examples.text: Er hat die Ansprüche nicht erfüllt.
